subtitles.en: 98,000 jobs created during the month of June, according to ADP in the private sector, of course, that is lower than had been anticipated.
subtitles.zh: ADP数据显示，6月私营部门新增9.8万个就业岗位，低于预期。

subtitles.en: Economists were looking for about 120,000 after 122 last month.
subtitles.zh: 经济学家此前预计约12万，上月为12.2万。

subtitles.en: If you look at the breakdown, you're seeing 2,000 jobs in the goods-producing area as natural resources and mining lost 5,000 in manufacturing, gain 5,000, that left construction jobs up
subtitles.zh: 分项来看，商品生产领域新增2000个岗位，自然资源和采矿业减少5000个，制造业增加5000个，建筑业增加2000个。

subtitles.en: by 2,000 as the goods-producing side of it.
subtitles.zh: 商品生产领域整体增加2000个岗位。

subtitles.en: In service-producing jobs, trade and transportation in the utilities up 15,000 education and health services, 48,000, which is an interesting number because, of course, June is when a lot of
subtitles.zh: 服务生产领域，贸易运输和公用事业增加1.5万，教育和健康服务增加4.8万，这个数字很有意思，因为6月很多教师不再工作。
zh_highlights: 教育和健康服务增加4.8万

subtitles.en: teachers are no longer working anymore, leisure and hospitality, only 2,000 jobs.
subtitles.zh: 休闲和酒店业仅增加2000个岗位。

subtitles.en: Now, the Fed has been worried about whether or not we are seeing pay increases as their focus shifts to inflation, and according to the ADP report, those who are staying in their
subtitles.zh: 美联储一直担心薪资增长，ADP报告显示，留任者薪资涨幅为4.4%，与上月持平。

subtitles.en: jobs, that pay increases of 4.4%, same as last month, but year-over-year pay growth for job changes accelerated to 6.6%, so that's something to keep an eye on tomorrow when we get average
subtitles.zh: 但跳槽者薪资同比涨幅加速至6.6%，明天关注平均时薪数据。
明天关注平均时薪数据。

results.title: June Private Payrolls Rise 98,000, Missing Forecasts - Market Daily
results.snippet: Private-sector hiring cooled in June, with U.S . companies adding a seasonally adjusted 98,000 jobs , according to the ADP National Employment Report released July 1 . The figure fell short of economist forecasts near 110,000 to 120,000 and marked a decline from May's 122,000, adding to signs that job creation is losing momentum ahead of the government's more closely watched payrolls report ...

results.title: US Private Hiring Remains Strong In June As ADP Reports 98,000 New Jobs
results.snippet: US private-sector job creation was solid again in June, capping the best three-month stretch for hiring in more than a year. Company payrolls rose by 98,000 after a 122,000 increase in the prior month, according to ADP Research data out Wednesday. The median estimate in a Bloomberg survey of economists called for a 120,000 increase.
